verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a client of a cloud developer platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents choosing a storage region or residency for GitHub Mobile or the underlying GitHub account. The only privacy-adjacent item is the public-code-matching suggestion setting, which is a different control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
